intent: Answer the ranking query immediately with the #1 state and its exact value, then explain why the top and bottom states land where they do, with concrete, true, interesting context.
style: clear, explanatory, interesting to read, concise, mobile-friendly
avoid: regional narratives not visible in the table
exact_phrase_rule: Use the primary keyword naturally in the title, H1, and the first sentence of quick_answer[0].
anti_template_bans: Do not open with 'When it comes to...'
Do not open with a vague superlative
Do not open with setup or background before the #1 value
Do not restate the ranking three different ways in the intro
good_intro_examples: Nevada has more casinos than any other state. It legalized gambling statewide in 1931, decades before any other state.
Alaska has the most volcanoes because it sits on the Pacific Ring of Fire, where the Pacific Plate dives under North America.
Harvard University, founded in 1636, is the oldest college in the United States. It opened just six years after the Massachusetts Bay Colony was established.
good_title_examples: Highest Point by State | Names, Map & Elevations
Oldest City in Each State | Map, Founding Year & History
Teacher Salary by State 2026 | Map & Rankings
bad_template_examples: When it comes to [topic], [State] stands out.
This ranking offers valuable insight into [State].
[State] ranks first, with twice as many as [State]. [State] ranks last.
States That Border Colorado | All 7, Map
